title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Fundamentals Customer Engagement Apps (MB-910)

nodes.title: Part 1: Key Ideas
nodes.content: Quick primer on Part 1. Tap to flip cards covering the most-asked exam ideas in this domain.

flashcards.front: A B2B software company wants a single Dynamics 365 app that helps sellers manage prospects, track a pipeline of opportunities, forecast revenue by quarter, and hand qualified deals to account managers. Which app should they roll out?
flashcards.back: Dynamics 365 Sales is purpose-built for the seller journey: leads, opportunities, product catalog, forecasts, sales pipeline analytics, and hand-off workflows. Customer Service manages post-sale support cases and SLAs, Field Service dispatches on-site work orders, and Business Central is an ERP for finance and inventory — none of them own the pre-sale pipeline experience.

flashcards.front: In Dynamics 365 Sales, a marketing list produces a raw prospect that the sales team has not yet contacted or verified. Which record type best represents that prospect before it is judged worth pursuing?
flashcards.back: A Lead in Dynamics 365 Sales is exactly that — an unqualified potential customer captured from a source like a web form or event, and it stays a Lead until it is qualified. Once qualified, it becomes an Opportunity (a deal being actively worked). A Quote is a priced proposal produced from an Opportunity, and a Case is a Customer Service support ticket, not a sales artifact.

flashcards.front: A support manager wants incoming email and web-form cases to be automatically classified, prioritized, and routed to the right team queue based on skills and workload rather than manual triage. Which Dynamics 365 Customer Service capability does that?
flashcards.back: Unified routing is the AI-assisted work-distribution engine in Customer Service. It classifies incoming work items (email, chat, cases, records) with rulesets and machine-learning models, then assigns them to the best-fit queue or agent based on skills, capacity, and priority. Duplicate detection prevents duplicate records but does not route them, business process flows guide a user through stages but do not distribute work, and forecasting is a Sales feature.

flashcards.front: A utilities firm dispatches technicians to install and repair equipment on customer premises. Their dispatchers need to visualize open jobs on a map, drag them onto technicians, and see travel time and required skills at a glance. Which Dynamics 365 app is designed for this workflow?
flashcards.back: Field Service is built around dispatching work orders to on-site technicians. Its Schedule Board and Schedule Assistant let dispatchers visualize work on a map and calendar, drag bookings onto resources, and honor skill, territory, and travel constraints. Sales owns pre-sale deals, Customer Insights - Journeys orchestrates marketing outreach, and Project Operations plans consulting engagements with time and expense — none of them provide the on-site dispatch board.

nodes.title: Microsoft Dataverse: Key Ideas
nodes.content: Dataverse is the data platform underneath the Power Platform — a managed, relational store with built-in security, business logic, and a uniform Web API. PL-400 leans on it heavily: most Power Apps, plug-ins, and automations read and write Dataverse.

flashcards.front: What is a Dataverse table (formerly entity)?
flashcards.back: A table is a typed set of rows with columns, relationships, keys, and its own security. Standard tables (Account, Contact) ship with the platform; custom tables are added per solution. Each table exposes an OData/Web API endpoint automatically.

flashcards.front: How do you query Dataverse from code?
flashcards.back: Use the Web API — an OData v4 REST endpoint at /api/data/v9.x. GET with $select/$filter/$expand for reads, POST/PATCH/DELETE for writes. The SDK (IOrganizationService) wraps the same operations for plug-ins and server-side code.

flashcards.front: How is access controlled in Dataverse?
flashcards.back: Security roles grant privileges (create/read/write/delete/append) at access levels (user, business unit, parent-child, organization). Rows are owned by a user or team; business units scope visibility. This is row- and column-level security, not just table-level.

flashcards.front: Business rules vs plug-ins for logic?
flashcards.back: Business rules are no-code, run on the form and server for simple validation/defaults. Plug-ins are .NET code on the event pipeline for complex or cross-table logic. Prefer the lightest tool that meets the requirement — business rules first, plug-ins when you need real code.

questions.q: In Dynamics 365 Field Service, a truck-mounted diagnostic device needs to be tracked as a schedulable resource that dispatchers can book onto work orders alongside technicians. Which bookable resource type fits?
questions.explanation: Bookable resources in Field Service come in five types — User, Contact, Account, Equipment, and Crew — and Equipment is the one meant for non-human assets like vehicles, tools, and instruments that need to be scheduled onto work orders. User is an internal Dataverse user (typically a technician), Contact is an external individual, and Account is a company. Equipment lets the Schedule Assistant treat the diagnostic truck as a first-class bookable resource.

questions.q: Every Dynamics 365 customer engagement app — Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, and Customer Insights - Journeys — writes its accounts, contacts, and cases to the same shared, relational, low-code data platform. What is that platform called?
questions.explanation: Microsoft Dataverse is the managed, RLS-secured data service that stores tables like Account, Contact, Case, and Opportunity for every customer engagement app. Because all apps share the same Dataverse tables, a contact created in Sales is immediately visible to Customer Service without integration. SharePoint stores unstructured documents, ADLS Gen2 is a big-data file store, and OneDrive is personal file storage — none of them provide the relational, business-rule-enforcing table model that Dynamics 365 apps require.

questions.q: A marketing team wants to trigger a multi-step outreach — welcome email, then a reminder if the customer does not click, then an SMS if they visit the pricing page — that reacts to each customer's real-time behavior. Which Dynamics 365 capability is designed for this?
questions.explanation: Customer Insights - Journeys (the rebrand that unified Dynamics 365 Marketing) provides real-time journeys — trigger-based, event-driven orchestrations that respond to individual customer signals like page visits, email opens, and form submissions across email, SMS, and push channels. Sales sequences guide a seller through internal follow-up steps but do not orchestrate customer-facing outreach, work orders track dispatch not marketing, and the knowledge base is a searchable article store for support agents.

questions.q: A retailer has customer data spread across an e-commerce database, a loyalty system, and a POS system, and wants Dynamics 365 to build unified customer profiles by matching, merging, and enriching those sources before segments can be built. Which product handles this data-unification role?
questions.explanation: Customer Insights - Data (formerly Customer Insights Audience Insights) is the customer data platform half of the Customer Insights family. It ingests data from multiple sources, runs match-and-merge to build unified profiles, enriches them, and produces segments and measures that Customer Insights - Journeys and Sales can activate. Dynamics 365 Sales is a CRM app, not a CDP; Field Service dispatches on-site work; and Excel is a general-purpose spreadsheet without match-and-merge or segmentation as a managed service.

nodes.title: Power Apps: canvas, model-driven, and PCF: Key Ideas
nodes.content: Power Apps is the app layer of the Power Platform. PL-400 expects you to know when to use a canvas app vs a model-driven app, and how to extend either with code components (PCF).

flashcards.back: Canvas apps give pixel-level control over the UI and can connect to many data sources — best for task-focused, tailored experiences. Model-driven apps are generated from the Dataverse data model and security — best for complex, data-centric line-of-business apps where consistency matters more than custom layout.

flashcards.front: What is the Power Apps Component Framework (PCF)?
flashcards.back: PCF lets you build reusable code components (controls) in TypeScript/HTML that plug into canvas and model-driven apps, replacing or augmenting standard fields and grids. Use it when no out-of-the-box control meets the UX requirement.

flashcards.front: How do canvas apps talk to data?
flashcards.back: Through connectors. Dataverse is the native, most capable connector; others reach SQL, SharePoint, or any REST API via custom connectors. Delegation matters: push filtering/sorting to the source so you don't hit the local record cap on large datasets.

A wrapper around a REST API (described by an OpenAPI/Swagger definition) that makes its operations available to Power Apps and Power Automate. It handles auth (API key, OAuth2) and surfaces actions as first-class steps — the standard way to integrate an external system.

questions.q: A service manager needs a contract that defines what a customer is entitled to — for example, 40 hours of phone support per year, expiring on a specific date — and that automatically decrements as cases are logged. Which Customer Service concept represents this contract?
questions.explanation: An entitlement in Customer Service is exactly this contract-of-support record: it defines the products, channels, and terms (a total number of cases or hours, and start/end dates) that a customer is entitled to consume, and each linked case decrements the remaining balance. Queues route work items but do not enforce support terms, business process flows guide agents through steps, and marketing segments live in Customer Insights - Journeys.

questions.q: Users open Sales Hub or Customer Service Hub in a browser and see a navigation of tables, forms, views, and dashboards that is generated from Dataverse metadata rather than hand-coded screens. Which Power Apps app type delivers these Dynamics 365 experiences?
questions.explanation: Dynamics 365 customer engagement hubs like Sales Hub, Customer Service Hub, and the Field Service app are model-driven apps — their UI is generated from the Dataverse data model (tables, columns, relationships, forms, views) plus configuration, not from pixel-perfect hand-drawn screens. Canvas apps are the drag-and-drop, pixel-controlled Power Apps model, SharePoint pages are collaboration content, and Power BI reports are analytics — none of them are how the Dynamics 365 hubs are built.

questions.q: A seller opens an opportunity in Dynamics 365 Sales and asks for a summary of recent activity, a draft follow-up email in the customer's tone, and suggested next steps based on the deal's history. Which built-in capability provides these generative-AI assistants inside Sales?
questions.explanation: Copilot in Dynamics 365 Sales is the embedded generative-AI assistant that summarizes records, drafts emails grounded in CRM context, produces meeting recaps, and suggests next-best actions from opportunity history — all in the flow of the seller's app. Power Automate desktop flows are RPA for legacy UIs, Azure ML designer trains custom models outside Dynamics, and SSRS produces paginated reports; none of them provide the in-app conversational assistant experience.

questions.q: A dispatcher receives a customer request to fix a broken pump. In Dynamics 365 Field Service, which record is created to represent the on-site job that will be scheduled to a technician, list the required parts and tasks, and be signed off when the work is complete?
questions.explanation: A work order in Field Service is the central object of the on-site job: it captures the incident type, service tasks, required products and skills, the customer location, and the scheduled resource(s), and it drives the technician's mobile experience through completion and sign-off. Opportunity and Lead are Sales pipeline records, and a Case in Customer Service captures a remote support issue — it may generate a work order, but the work order itself is the field-dispatch record.
